replaced.reason: mocks collectFiles to throw; run_files prints the same single line for any selection Err, which only a race reaches

replaced.test: a fix that does not parse leaves the file untouched
replaced.reason: spies on processFile to break its output; step.rs format_text turns a fixed text parse error into this finding, and the Rust engine has no seam to inject one

replaced.test: a fix the engine already parsed with an error leaves the file untouched

replaced.test: a failed in place write restores the original
replaced.reason: spies on writeFileSync to fail after a partial write; format.rs write_in_place writes the original bytes back, a failure no real input forces, so no Rust test reaches it

replaced.test: a directory git could not open fails with no code
replaced.reason: spies on accessSync so access and git disagree; collect_files drops the code when searchable passes, which only a race reaches

replaced.test: --fix --stdin output that does not parse is left as the input
replaced.reason: spies on processFile to break its output; run_stdin echoes the input whenever no fixed text is kept, and the Rust engine has no seam to produce unparsable fixed text
